comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/52067284 (Camelback Mountain Resort): the north face of Camelback Mountain in Big Pocono State Park, from the Summit House to Mountain Village and the Snow Tubing Park, on one ticket and one map (Ikon); it holds every lift and run. No other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-12 against Camelback's 2025-26 trail map (trail-map-2025-26.jpg, the James Niehues painting camelbackresort.com/trail-map shows, 1440 x 720 px, the only size the site serves, read enlarged four times). Its legend: Easier - Novice (green circle), More Difficult - Intermediate (blue square), Most Difficult - Expert (one black diamond) and Extremely Difficult - Advanced Expert (two), as OSM's novice and easy, intermediate, advanced and expert; Slow Zone (green hatching) and Terrain Park (orange hatching, features S, M and L); and its lift list L1 Raceway, L2 The Glen, L5 Black Bear 6, L6 Bailey, L7 Meadows, L8 Stevenson Express, L9 Sunbowl, L10 Kids Learning Center Carpet I, L11 Sunbowl Carpet, L12 Coolmoor Carpet, L13 Ski & Ride Academy Carpet, L14 Beginner Carpet and the tubing park's L15 Tubing I and L16 Tubing II. The resort's snow report loads its trail status by script, so the printed map is the only source and wins. OpenStreetMap draws most runs twice, as a line and as an outline (area=yes) with the same tags; each override names both ways. Of OSM's named runs, all carry the map's rating but Sphinx (green on the map; intermediate in OSM, one line). Names from the map: Basilisk (OSM Basalisk), Julius Caesar (Julius Caeser), Little Caesar (Little Ceasar), Bactrian (Bactrain), Oak Grove (Oak Groove) and Old Main Line (Old Main Lane), and the carpets L10 Kids Learning Center Carpet I (OSM Kids Learning Center I) and L11 Sunbowl Carpet (OSM Kids Learning Center Carpet II); Cool Moor (COOLMOOR) differs only by a space and stays. Parks: the terrain park's three trails, Rhododendron Glen, Upper Moore's Ramble and Oak Grove, are snow parks in OSM already (with the map's ratings: blue, green, green). Hidden: the Marc Antony (L3) and Cleopatra (L4) chairs, which OSM still maps between The Glen and Black Bear 6 and which the 2025-26 map neither draws nor lists (its numbers skip from L2 to L5), and their bottom stations, which lie within 100 m of the Sunbowl chair and would draw as circles with no lift. The tubing park's two carpets stay, on the map's lift list; its tubing lanes are left out by the type rule, as is a hiking path. OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): the L14 Beginner Carpet; Home Again (green, from Honeymoon to the Sunbowl) and the Progression Park beside Dromedary are not named in OSM, though OSM's unnamed easy outlines may hold them.
